settings.content: Bot protection for your storefront forms. Get your Site Key from the Redeyed Lab → Developer → Sentinel → Sites. The Site Key is public and safe to store here. NEVER paste your secret API Key into the theme — it belongs on a server (see the app-proxy-verify example).

settings.label: Site Key
settings.info: Public Site Key for this storefront (e.g. sk_live_xxxxxxxx).

settings.label: Base URL
settings.info: Redeyed API/widget base URL. Leave as the default unless you run a self-hosted or staging instance.
